1. (Currently Amended) A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm __that has been trained on historical database operations and their actual execution characteristics__; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output __wherein the database operation predictor comprises a predicted value that differs from cost estimates provided by the database optimizer__; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct __wherein the modification is performed prior to query execution and is based on machine-learning derived predictions rather than optimizer cost models__; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated Central Process Unit (CPU) execution time __derived from the machine-learning algorithm__ for one or more Access Module Processors to execute when processing the database operation __wherein said estimated CPU execution time is distinct from CPU cost estimates generated by the database optimizer__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein obtaining further includes acquiring the database operation predictor as an estimated number of Input/Output (I/O) operations __derived from the machine-learning algorithm__ performed by one or more Access Module Processors during execution when processing the database operation __wherein said estimated I/O operations is distinct from I/O cost estimates generated by the database optimizer__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer __and actual historical execution metrics for database operations__; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query __derived from the machine-learning algorithm__ based on the least cost query execution plan __wherein the predicted execution time differs from execution time estimates provided by the database optimizer__; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time __wherein such modifications are made prior to query execution based on machine-learning derived predictions__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and management component of a database system __wherein the database tool displays machine-learning predicted execution times alongside optimizer-generated cost estimates__.

19. (Currently Amended) A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm __trained on historical database operations and their actual execution characteristics__; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value __derived from machine-learning analysis__ relevant to one of: one or more of the database constructs and the database operation __wherein the predicted value differs from cost or performance estimates provided by the database optimizer__; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predicted value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system __based on machine-learning derived predictions rather than optimizer estimates__.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time __derived from the machine-learning algorithm__ for a query __wherein said estimated query execution time differs from execution time estimates provided by the database optimizer__ and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system.
